# Two sandbox drain measurements — coordination owner
2026-10-07 09:42 MST. Coordination owns arranging the two measurements, not production implementation or integration. backlog-implementer-v3 retains sole fix-day implementation ownership.

## Obtained evidence
Read implementer worktree notes docs/plans/2026-10-07-fix-day-notes.md and /tmp/aida-fix-day-evidence/sandbox-{1,2}.log, sandbox-results.json.
Reported last code checkpoint c418c60fe7a58058fbea577b55e85bdbea1e1f65. Binary /home/joe/ai/aida-fix-day-2026-10-07/target/debug/aida --version reports c418c60fe7+dirty, built 2026-10-07 09:38:10 -07:00; notes attribute dirty to evidence notes only. No clean-source binary claim. Need v3 confirmation final checkpoint/freeze and runnable fixture before rerunning.
Run 1 repo /tmp/aida-fix-day-sandboxes-484ycwh8/run-1/repo, AIDA_STORE /tmp/aida-fix-day-sandboxes-484ycwh8/run-1/store.
Run 2 repo /tmp/aida-fix-day-sandboxes-484ycwh8/run-2/repo, AIDA_STORE /tmp/aida-fix-day-sandboxes-484ycwh8/run-2/store.
Each ran final branch binary: burndown run --tag sandbox --max 3 --concurrency 3. Both exit 1: starting an autonomous drain needs dispatch authority (product, advisor, or integrator role, or a live orchestrator).
Actual aggregate outcomes: shipped 0; launch-refused NOT MEASURED (no phase-one child launched); other 2 driver-authority refusals. Two blocked attempts are not completed three-spec drains. Do not manufacture six member failures or a success-rate comparison.

## Dispatch/delegation preflight
Source has_dispatch_authority requires validated product/advisor/integrator seat or corroborated live orchestrator; companion role is refused. AIDA_SESSION_ROLE display alone does not grant authority. Choose authoritative advisor driver at HUMAN terminal for sandbox only.
Current coordination grant is advisor but delegates only advisor. It lacks implementer/reviewer/integrator child delegation and cannot be repaired by this managed agent. Standard role enter issuance requires direct human TTY and refuses managed-agent issuance. Do not mint grant records, --force, spoof TTY, bypass roster/email checks, clear holds or use real store.
Headless phase launcher calls seat_authority::issue_child for its actual seat; child grants default to empty delegation. Before launch verify actual child seat chain and inherited delegations; granting a root seat must not be misrepresented as proving grandchildren work. Prepare advisor, implementer, reviewer, integrator ceilings/delegations via supported human-terminal commands, report any narrower/deeper chain refusal rather than relaxing checks.

## Fixture blockers independently observed
Existing repos have no remote. Seeded store specs are lifecycle/relationship tutorials (e.g. TASK-016 asks to walk statuses, TASK-017 asks to inspect dependency graph), not three concrete ship-capable code tasks. Store list shows queued=false. Thus authority repair alone does NOT establish three-spec shipped measurement. Need independent disposable runnable fixtures, isolated queue/store/forge setup and exact selection/child-chain preflight. Never borrow real store/queue/specs or push a sandbox branch to production remote.

## Arrangement and handoffs
Ask v3 to confirm exact final code SHA, binary version/build SHA and dirty scope, sandbox paths, exact prior commands/refusal logs, full native session identity, whether fixtures were meant only as launch probes, and whether binary may be frozen/copied for measurements.
Ask backlog-regression to prepare measurement recipe/fixtures against that checkpoint, with sandbox-only queue and throwaway forge/remote, real authority gates intact; report direct-human grant/child-chain requirements and dry-run ready set before launch. This testing work must not modify implementation worktree or share its branch. Coordinate two sequential independent sandbox runs only after authorized driver/grant and three runnable selected specs are established.
Acceptance backlog-verifier-1 receives exact binary/source SHA plus two raw run logs and per-member outcomes; classify shipped, launch-refused and other from actual phase telemetry/receipts, including driver preflight outcomes separately. One final whole-branch review remains unchanged.

## Exact human-terminal authority/preflight action (run separately for N=1 and N=2)
Use a NORMAL human shell, not managed-agent shell. The command is sandbox-local; no production authority mutation.
cd /tmp/aida-fix-day-sandboxes-484ycwh8/run-1/repo
export AIDA_STORE=/tmp/aida-fix-day-sandboxes-484ycwh8/run-1/store
export PATH=/home/joe/ai/aida-fix-day-2026-10-07/target/debug:$PATH
aida team allow-seat joe advisor
aida team allow-seat joe implementer
aida team allow-seat joe reviewer
aida team allow-seat joe integrator
eval "$(aida role enter advisor --no-resume --delegate-seat advisor --delegate-seat implementer --delegate-seat reviewer --delegate-seat integrator)"
aida --version
aida burndown run --tag sandbox --max 3 --concurrency 3 --dry-run

Replace run-1 with run-2 for second sandbox. Run only after binary/fixture confirmation; record role issuance and dry-run output. The CURRENT tutorial fixtures/unqueued selection/no remote are not ready for E2E shipping. After authorized recipe confirms three ship-capable selected specs and child delegation, actual run command is:
aida burndown run --tag sandbox --max 3 --concurrency 3 --verbose
Capture full output/exit code without a pipe masking exit; return logs, run IDs, binary/source SHA and all member outcomes. No success claimed until measured. Exact role-issuance command above requires human because seat_authority.rs require_direct_human enforces direct TTY, non-managed agent; no automatic review rejection occurred.

## Next action
Confirm v3 final checkpoint and get regression fixture/seat-chain recipe. Supply operator concrete runnable final commands for two runs. Record outcomes on TASK-1603 and this handoff; no overlapping implementation, no integration approval/merge/hold clearance, no lease pruning.
subject: Sandbox measurements owned: two prelaunch refusals, fixture and human delegation prerequisites
